author: root Codex positive mechanism design and critical concurrency analysis
status: Conditional design and source review; no shared RTL implementation or new shared graph execution
rule: Freeze K consumers before first physical ARVALID. Each has independent successful source READ plus stable continuous destination WRITE prefix Ci. Admit one unsplit N-word shared source envelope if Ui=N-Ci<=Qi for every recipient, where Qi is actual exclusive private return capacity. Write only each independently authorized resident prefix; keep all tail words until each own next-page WRITE permission arrives.
new_capability: None of the consumers needs a fully prepared destination envelope or a permanent full-permission sponsor. Under the conditions below all physical source R including RLAST can finish with the existing private payload storage, so missing destination PTE responses serialized behind that RLAST can return. True source payload is fetched once; no recipient is dropped/re-read.

difference_from_stage54.old_contract: R ingress blocks at each required consumer WRITE frontier; long shared admission requires V fully WRITE-certified. A may detach and later re-read, but V must sponsor the complete long source return.
difference_from_stage54.new_contract: READ permission authorizes accepting source data into reserved private storage, while WRITE permission separately gates actual destination writes. Ui<=Qi permits buffering the complete unauthorized-to-write tail without requiring any full-WRITE sponsor.
difference_from_stage54.implementation_delta: Do not erase an old permission check alone. Replace it with per-consumer real capacity ownership and whole-envelope admission before first ARVALID, preserve frozen per-recipient logical R handshake and held packets, and remove only the incompatible prefix group barrier under the explicitly prepared/fully resident child contract.

proof_conditions: Same immutable Normal memory physical source and compatible source attributes; every consumer owns its own successful READ permission, stable mappings and no alias/overlap/MMIO/atomic. Same PA never substitutes for authorization.
One ordered physical source AR and a frozen consumer set; no pause, late joins or unrelated unreserved return into these private Qi slots.

Every authorized prefix can write independently of other consumers' frontier, cursor or group-equality barrier. Each physical child is entirely authorized and its complete real payload is resident before first AWVALID. All actual W/B and consumer services are eventually granted.
Do not borrow shared skid as K independent storage allocations. Count its frozen pending-mask separately; the theorem uses private Qi only.

All source/WRITE retained grants and whole-job primer survive multiple original producer AW/B parents. Tail PTE is requested/routed independently of source logical completion and fault reporting; no successful permission is assumed ahead of its actual response.
rank_argument: Consider a consumer preventing delivery of the next physical word because its private FIFO is full. If its head is inside Ci, a fully resident authorized child can drain through fair W/B service independently of future R/PTE or any peer group. If its head is at/after Ci, all prefix has been consumed; its entire still-returning suffix is at most Ui<=Qi and fits. Serialized logical broadcast can therefore eventually deliver each word to every consumer; the final physical word can be accepted even when no consumer has full destination permission.

same_budget_controls.full_prepare_shared: Keep the same shared source, source authorization and private return storage, but prepare both destination regions for every consumer before one physical AR. This completes with one AR too; total prepares unchanged.
same_budget_controls.min_frontier_shared_split: Issue first shared AR ending at min(Ci), prepare necessary destination pages after that RLAST, then issue the shared suffix AR. This can complete with two AR and exactly N physical source words, without source re-read. It can obtain tail permission earlier and may be faster.
same_budget_controls.what_is_not_a_control: Do not compare only independent reads or force the ordinary shared source to wait for all tail permissions throughout the prefix. Do not reject novelty solely by imagining a controller that adds the candidate predicate.

platform_geometry.source: One aligned256-word source AR within its4KiB source page (e.g. page offset0 or0x800); current legalizer max length256 at64-bit gives2KiB max source envelope.
platform_geometry.destinations: A offset0x818 -> Ci253/Ui3, B offset0x810 -> Ci254/Ui2. Both private Qi3 meet condition; neither fullWRITE. Original destination parents are253+3 and254+2 independently of the source AR.
platform_geometry.production_limit: Current DMA0/1 buffer512, others3; the equal-small-Q shared prototype is a prospective configuration, not a current four-small-flow board result.
platform_geometry.required_configuration: decouple_rw1,deburst0, current RAW_COUPLING_AVAIL0. Otherwise native legalizer already splits source at destination boundary. A newly enabled first-R AW coupler must handle one-source/multiple-AW credits explicitly.

work_accounting.candidate: One physical source AR, N physical real R, K*N destination true W, all source READ permissions independently valid, K first destination regions before launch and total2*K regions by completion in the two-page case. All physical child AW/B and synthetic writes must be counted if future scheduling changes.
work_accounting.split_control: Two physical source AR, the same N physical real R and K*N true W; no payload-traffic advantage is established over this best shared split control.
work_accounting.performance: Reduced startup destination preparation and one fewer source AR are distinct capabilities. They do not imply earlier complete ACK, fewer total walks or a wallclock bound.

joint_debt_next.problem: Allowing nonresident write debt instead of fully resident children reopens cross-flow HOL: current W owner A can need the next common R while consumer V has a full authorized FIFO and cannot write behind A. Ui<=Qi alone does not break this cycle.
joint_debt_next.positive_next_design: Before any sharedW claim bound missing real words L-r<=delta; retain its own WRITE permission; when source stalls, drain the physical child with legal zero-strobe words independently of future R, absorb actual B, preserve source data and complete true suffix later. Every repair must have actual true progress or be fully resident. Combine that physical escape with Ui<=Qi source admission rather than claiming either inequality alone proves global liveness.
joint_debt_next.acceptance_gate: Only one legal postcommit cross-flow cycle plus resident-only, full-prepare and shared-split controls is needed next. Charge physical AW/B/null and all consumers complete ACK; no new large matrix. Published protocol/error timeout uses and normal successful retained-source continuation must be distinguished by actual code/evidence.

novelty_judgment: Because CutForward and AXI-REALM already provide resident write release/parent adaptation, those components are common. Because stage54 requires a full-WRITE sponsor, this extends our own earlier capability. If exact prior hardware has the same all-consumer partial-permission suffix reservation, reproduce its limitation instead. If exact primary comparisons leave this new read/write commitment rule and a relevant full-cost benefit, it can be a narrow paper contribution; no first-publication or tier judgment is made.
